top_signals.title: CISA gives federal agencies two weeks to patch Microsoft bug exploited in DPRK campaign
top_signals.summary: Researchers disclosed the bug to Microsoft after examining a long-running campaign by North Korean hackers to exploit the job application process.

top_signals.title: Walter’s Firm Seeks Cash to Pay Down Loans Amid DOJ Probe
top_signals.summary: Billionaire Mark Walter’s firm is in talks with investors to raise money to help pay down loans on the books of its insurers that had drawn scrutiny from the Justice Department, according to people familiar with the matter.
